    Our Journey

    bigbasket is the brainchild of five entrepreneurs - V.S Sudhakar, Hari Menon, V.S Ramesh, Vipul Parekh, and Abhinay Choudhari. What started out with a seed capital of less than $ 1 million grew to cross the $ 1 billion mark in gross annual sales within just 10 years.

    Our core business is best described as a one-stop destination for a wide range of products across categories covering Fruits & Vegetables; Staples; Meat, Fish & Eggs; FMCG; as well as Beauty & Personal Care. Having covered all major T1 and T2 cities, we are now branching out to T4 cities where there is significant potential for growth in e-commerce and a huge market yet to be conquered.

    bbnow is our entry into the quick commerce space with a 15 – 30 mins delivery system that serves as channel for fulfilling our customers’ quick & emergency needs.

    bbdaily is our daily subscription model through which customers can subscribe for their daily needs.

    Fresho stores mark our entry into offline retailing where we are creating a unique technology driven in-store experience for customers.

    bbmandi is our B2B business that involves selling and providing freshly procured fruits & vegetables to local grocery suppliers.

    bbinstant was India’s first unmanned cashless smart store. bbinstant vending machines are currently placed in various corporates, institutions and large apartment complexes.

    bbsaathi is our B2B marketplace where we enable and partner with retailer, local businesses, hotel and kirana shop owners for the sale and delivery of FMCG and groceries.

    Diversity & Inclusion

    Taking forward our philosophy and journey of creating a truly diverse & equitable workforce, we launched AARAMBH - bigbasket's diversity & inclusion initiative in 2019 to embrace differences and set benchmarks of best practices. We pledge our commitment towards these ideals by inculcating an environment where people feel heard, respected and empowered. By embracing differences, we gain the benefit of varied views and perspectives. This is how we nurture and celebrate uniqueness, creating a happier space where every individual's contribution is valued.

    Early Careers Program

    Engineering Internship

    The programme provides engineering students with opportunities to innovate and excel in the field of technology. Students get to work with diverse teams and a collaborative network of peers & mentors on cross-functional projects.

    Summer Internship

    Through this programme, bigbasket makes it possible for students to achieve their fullest potential. We nurture talent and equip them to contribute to a better future while exploring exciting new opportunities.

    Management Trainee Programme

    We believe that the best-in-the-business thoughts come from the best-in-class people. Through this programme, we help accelerate the growth and development of such exemplary talent with the hope of producing tomorrow’s leaders.
